summary: The retained Windows x64 NSIS installer completed a locked 10/10 unattended fresh-container and fresh-prefix acceptance batch inside Docker Engine 29.6.2 in Ubuntu-24.04 WSL2 using Wine-Staging 11.21, the pinned visible-region candidate, winex11, XFCE/Xorgxrdp, Mesa llvmpipe, and Evergreen WebView2 157.0.4341.60. Every run rendered normally without the historical repaint helper, handled exact Unicode/space and deliberate missing-input paths, completed the real 8-file Rust workload, exercised native open/save/cancel/reopen/overwrite behavior, exported and independently validated JSON, preserved inputs and an existing destination, repainted after ordinary resize/restore, collected complete evidence, and cleaned its exact container. Technical feasibility is demonstrated. Full Octane acceptance is qualified only for the exact locked installer, profile, host, and schema-v3 contract; it is not a general Tauri/Wine guarantee.
